name: HP 524A electronic frequency counter
summary: Hewlett-Packard's 524A was a self-contained electronic counter that read frequencies up to 10 MHz directly as numbers, sparing engineers slow comparison methods.
description: Hewlett-Packard Model 524A frequency counter, a self-contained electronic counter with a direct numeric display.
